name: Spraynt SEO Mapper
author: Spraynt

sections.description:
Bulk update Yoast SEO meta titles and descriptions via CSV upload using Page URL as the identifier. Includes Simulation Mode to preview changes before applying them.

This plugin is designed for site owners and SEO managers who need to efficiently update large numbers of Yoast SEO fields without editing each page manually. By uploading a CSV file with URLs and new meta values, you can streamline SEO management across your WordPress site.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/spraynt-seo-mapper directory, or install via the WordPress Plugins screen.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Navigate to SEO Mapper in your WordPress admin menu.
  4. Upload your CSV file containing:
    • Page URL
    • Meta Title
    • Meta Description
  5. Run in Simulation Mode first to preview changes.
  6. Switch to Live Mode to apply updates.
sections.faq:
What format should the CSV file use?

The CSV must include at least three columns: Page URL, Meta Title, and Meta Description. The Page URL is used as the identifier.

What is Simulation Mode?

Simulation Mode allows you to preview which pages will be updated and what changes will be applied, without saving them to the database.

Does this plugin work without Yoast SEO?

No. It requires the Yoast SEO plugin to be installed and active.
